grid_overlay_implementation.function_source:
def grid_overlay(png: Path, out: Path, step: int = GRID) -> Path:
    """在整页图上画坐标网格。读图时照着网格报框，能把误差压到半格以内。"""
    img = Image.open(png).convert("RGB")
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for x in range(0, img.width, step):
        d.line([(x, 0), (x, img.height)], fill=(255, 120, 120), width=1)
        d.text((x + 3, 3), str(x), fill=(200, 0, 0))
    for y in range(0, img.height, step):
        d.line([(0, y), (img.width, y)], fill=(120, 160, 255), width=1)
        d.text((3, y + 3), str(y), fill=(0, 0, 200))
    img.save(out)
    return out
grid_overlay_implementation.proof: Draws grid lines and coordinate labels on an RGB conversion of the input canvas, using img.width/img.height; no resizing, cropping, rotation or coordinate transform.
